column1: # r5: the game image from 0x800E847C to its end (0x8010FD7C): names for the functions, the data they use,
# Reconciled with the other areas' maps (wave 1): docs/code/NAMING.md has the conventions, which override this
# header where they differ, and every decision; each old name has one row over all the maps; labels to delete
# rather than rename are in drop.tsv.
# struct fields read by raw offset, and files. docs/code/r5.md is the map of this area. Format: docs/port/PCONLY.md 3.

column6: note

empty 8-byte deleted-procedure stub, no callers: where MAT3 camera.c's static _UpdateDroneObjects stands (right before update_car_object); IDO inlined its body into CheckCameraView's last loop; deletable
MAT3 camera.c update_car_object: CopyUV, uvs[0..2][1] *= FSCLS by gFrameScale, ZOID_UpdateObject(car->objnum) when objnum >= 0
MAT3 point_at_car: optional update_car_object, elasticity 0 when resurrecting else 0.6*elastic_factor scaled by gLastFrameCount 3/4/5 (0.75/0.6/0.5), blend camera pos, LookInDir
MAT3 maxpath_cam: mode 0 stores start/last point, path, gModelTime, 0; else walks NextPathPt by (100 + 1.4666667*(rwmph>>2))*dt feet, +10 up, point_at_car
MAT3 init_view3: saveview = view = 2, rear_y/rear_z by gGameState & 8, view3_switch = 1 (N64 attract height differs from GC's)
MAT3 camera.c static _UpdateRearCamera(car, behind, side, camoff) (underscore dropped as the tree does): view 8/4 cases, MAX 100 ft/s, Interpolate, elastic_factor

MAT3 steady_move_cam: mode 0 sets start pos and LookInDir; stages 0/1 blend toward _UpdateRearCamera offset over legDuration, stage 2 init_view3 + saved view (GetPlayerCarView); prototype in include/game/camera.h
MAT3 fix_camera_in_space: modes 0/1 store cam_pos/cam_mode, else zoom by (dist-50)*k+20 and point_at_car
MAT3 circle_camera_around_car: finish_cam 1 -> 2 after 10 s, angle from ms % 6000, radius 15, height 10
MAT3 DeathCam: ZOID_UpdateObject, elasticity 0.13, _UpdateRearCamera(car, 30, 16), blend, LookInDir
MAT3 UpdateCarObj: update_car_object, _UpdateRearCamera with -rear_z for view 10, point_at_car(car, carpos, 0, res)
MAT3 View3Cam: rear_z/rear_y (-6/-2 for view 3), zf/yf blends from gTireCnt/gSusAvg, last_zvec/last_yvec elastic, uvector/rvector, builds fcam uvs and pos
MAT3 view1_suscomp_offset: 0.5*(reckon.suscomp[0]+[1]) - 0.3 clamped at 0 (model +0x75C/+0x760)
MAT3 update_camera: switch on car view 0..10 calling update_car_object/View3Cam/UpdateCarObj/DeathCam/circle/fix/steady/maxpath cams, CameraCollision; N64 has no rear-view button

MAT3 init_camera_on_track: (rwmph>>6)+n NextPathPt steps, trackSpots[gTrackNum] up to the -999 terminator within 200 ft (Distance2D), fix_camera_in_space(zoom), else random height + CameraCollision; was a wrong guess

MAT3 CheckCameraView: ghost-race camera cycling on pad 2, attract view switching (Random(11), lastSwitch/nextSwitch), view button, SavePlayerCarView, update_camera, gTireCnt/gSusAvg, BlinkResurrectingCars, inlined _UpdateDroneObjects
MAT3 mdrive.c Update_MDrive: update_game_data, ZOID_UpdateObject of cars 1..gNumPlayers-1 in a ghost race (gRace 2), CheckCameraView; prototype in include/game/car.h
MAT3 fake_init(trk): attract race, gTrackNum, gNumCars = 6, gLink owner/polepos/flags/track, attractSlot++ wrap 6 to gPlayers[0].slot and gCamera[0].slot, gUseCatchup = 2
MAT3 maxpath.c InitCarPath(m, gc): mpctl idx/xrel/yrel/interval_time/newIdx, drone path from static p (0..3), started if gCheckpoints.startPt == 0, lastResPath -1

MAT3 mdrive.c init_cars: clears model (keeping fastin.dt) and car, gCarModels[0], views 2, distance, collsize radius, gCarHandling..gTireRims tables, InitCarPath, sched_to_use (+7 for 2+ humans); was a wrong guess. port/assets/tests/test_roster.c has an unrelated static init_cars: rename that
MAT3 munge_gLink_data: we_control/drone_type/in_game from gLink, slot lists humans[]/drones[]/our_drones[], gModelIteration = 0
returns the index of the gResPath point nearest a short[3] position (squared distance, from 1e20); uncalled; no MAT3 function with this shape (FindClosestPathPt takes a drone path)

MAT3 maxpath.c FindMaxpathIntervals: per active car the nearest gResPath point (5-point search, 10000/40000/2500 thresholds, alt paths skipping resurrect 2, FindResPt) and gc->distance from laps, checkpoints and GetPathDistance; was a wrong guess
MAT3 HAL_text.c HAL_SetTextTranslucency: gTrans = x, attribute bit 0x20 off outside 0..255 else on + BlitXLU; already #defined to this in ovl_b/func_80392894.c
MAT3 HAL_SetFontSpacing: < 0 -> SetupFontData(0) and the font header's spacing, else the value (N64 without GC's *2); was a wrong guess
MAT3 HAL_SetFontLeading: < 0 -> SetupFontData(0) and the font header's leading, else the value; was a wrong guess
MAT3 HAL_FinishText(end): replays the buffered text commands 0..6 (font, leading, spacing, pos, translucency, colour, DrawText) under the text semaphore; was a wrong guess

N64 EndGraphics (MAT3 ngcGraph.c EndGraphics is the GC stub of the same platform call, Pal60 pairs it with StartGraphics): HAL_FinishText(1), closes the frame DL and the text DL, fills the frame's RSP task (rspboot, gfx ucode, stack, FIFO, yield), bumps gRenderInProgress, posts it to the scheduler; was a wrong guess

N64 StartGraphics (MAT3 ngcGraph.c StartGraphics: ClearFrame, BlitInit, HAL_StartText): sets up the frame's display list, clears Z and colour buffers, split-screen bars, filter/dither/VI options, then the blit init and HAL_StartText

the N64 main (graphics) thread's step: one message from main_thread_queue: 4 pre-NMI, 1 retrace (StartGraphics and wake the game thread when no frame is in flight), 2750 frame end (EndGraphics), 2 task done; no MAT3 counterpart (threads); was a wrong guess
MAT3 Init.c ExitSystem: empty; its one call, the start screen's option 9 after AudKillSong and AudStopAllEffects (ovl_a start_screen), is MAT3 startscr.c's exactly
empty retail stub of MAT3 HAL_text.c static _InitSemaphore, inlined into HAL_InitText; deletable
MAT3 HAL_InitText: _InitSemaphore (once: creates and posts the text semaphore queue on the N64) and gFontIndex = -1; was a wrong guess
MAT3 controls.c InitRushControls: InitControlSys, SetDefaultControls(gDefaultControls), copies gDefaultControls to gNewControls[4] (10 bytes each on the N64, 11 on GC); was a wrong guess

MAT3 camera.c InitCameras: its whole body is ZeroCameras() (particle_velocity_set, which the screens' initScreen call as MAT3's do); InitGraphics inlines it, so this copy is uncalled; was a wrong guess

8-byte deleted-procedure stub of N64 _InitGfx (MAT3 ngcGraph.c _InitGfx, underscore dropped): video options, field of view, framebuffers, frame records; the body is inlined into InitGraphics (src/blob/groups/initgraphics/initgfx.c keeps a C copy)
MAT3 gfx.c InitGraphics: _InitGfx, ZOID_Init, InitBlits, InitCameras (here ZeroCameras inlined); InitSystem inlines it, so this copy is uncalled; was a wrong guess
MAT3 Init.c InitSystem: SaveInit, InitGraphics, AudioInit, InitRushControls, SetControllerActive(-1, 0), pak and options init, timer, HAL_InitText; called by game_init (boot); was a wrong guess
MAT3 hud.c animGear: per player GEAR label at gearPos-4 and R/N/digit at gearPos+4, font by window count (src/blob/groups/animgear/animgear.c header)

MAT3 RenameBlit@blit.c: sets blit->name; preserve: MBOX_FindTexture(name, &texIndex, 0, gNumModels-1, warn) into the texture, else InitBlit; then UpdateBlit; animTach calls it with the TACHOMETER_MD/_SM names and 0 as MAT3 does

MAT3 animTach@hud.c: slot=(animID>>4)&15, type=animID&15, hidden past gNumWindows (animFunc 0 past gNumPlayers), RenameBlit TACHOMETER_MD/_SM, tachPos[gNumWindows-1][slot], needle 1.35*rpm*0.0001 clamped to 1, alpha 254
MAT3 animSpeed@hud.c: win=animID&15, show=(animID>>4)&15, the two Hidden tests (window count; !gShowSpeed or place_locked), font 4/1, x=speedPos-2*width('8'); draws no dust

MAT3 ShowHUD@hud.c: first call clears gCheckPtTimeout/gLapTime/gElapsedTime/gPlayerCoin, creates the HUD blit sets (NewMultiBlit), markers_valid 0; attract credits cycle (gCredit, gCorner, panes); no skid marks (include/game/hud.h already declares ShowHUD(void): the same function)
MAT3 fixword@highscorescr.c (also the arcade hiscore.c's): recursive match of an obscene word in the entered name, repeated letters tolerated, hits overwritten with '!'; statics op1/sp/cnt as MAT3
MAT3 censor@highscorescr.c: ORs fixword over every word of the obscenities list; ControlName calls it on the finished name
MAT3 _UninitScreen@highscorescr.c (static, also in two other screens; prefix as highscore_InitScreen): removes codePane, namePanes, score and ghost panes, inited 0, setGameState(0x800000) inlined

empty 8-byte function, never called: IDO's leftover of an inlined static; it sits where MAT3's ControlScores would be in callee-first order (after SetHighScoreState), and updateHighScoreScreen inlines ControlScores (state 5)

MAT3 ControlGhost@highscorescr.c: ghost-save menu input (gGhostMenuSelect up/down skipping unusable rows, gGhostPak left/right on gActiveLevels 0x3000, SaveGhost(pak, player, gSavedGhost, 0/1)), SetHighScoreState(5) on exit, then FindGhosts(gGhostPak); N64 confirm is a yes/no toggle

MAT3 FindTempNameIdx@gamerecords.c: ages the 20 temp names (13 bytes, gTempNameAges), returns the slot holding the name, else an empty one, else one no gTotalNames[12][3][5] entry uses, else the oldest; strcpy, age 0

MAT3 ControlName(p)@highscorescr.c: 9-column name grid with -1/-2/-3 end/delete/space cells on autoEdges 0x400/0x800/0x1000/0x2000, 12-character limit, censor, FindTempNameIdx, gTotalNames for the gNewTotalScore hits

empty 8-byte function, never called: IDO's leftover of an inlined static; it sits where MAT3's ControlCircuitCode would be (between ControlName and ControlUnlocked), and updateHighScoreScreen inlines ControlCircuitCode (state 2)
MAT3 ControlUnlocked@highscorescr.c: per player dismisses gStuffUnlocked on A/B or timeout (namePanes removed), then SetHighScoreState(circuitCode ? 2 : race 0/2/3 ? 3 : 0)

MAT3 _RankScores@highscorescr.c (underscore dropped as the tree does for PrintScores/FindGhosts/SetHighScoreState): gThisPlayer from gLastPlayer[controller] or the profile, gDrawName for gNewTotalScore hits, gScoreName from the temp names or the profile

MAT3 CalcUnlockedStuff@gamerecords.c: unlocked cars, transmissions, engines, tires, frames, tracks and circuits per player from coin counts (CountBits(...,16), thresholds 48/24/36/32/16/24) and stats, the three cheat overrides; nothing networked

empty 8-byte function, never called, right before ContinueCircuit: IDO's leftover of MAT3's static _CircuitRandom(max) (rand_r(&gCircuitSeed) % (max+1)), which ContinueCircuit inlines (net_session_update.c's header says the same)

MAT3 ContinueCircuit@circuit.c: gCircuitSeed from the save's circuit, gCircuitSize, drone names without repeats, shuffled drone order and 12 skill columns, gCircuitTracks (no repeats, fog/wind by type), 3-bit rank decode into places/points, totalPlace sort; nothing networked

MAT3 GetCircuitCode(code)@circuit.c: ContinueCircuit, gCircuitTrack--, NewPassword(86,14), StorePasswordElement type 3, death 1, track 5, seed 20, difficulty 3, six totalPoints of 9 bits, GetPasswordString

MAT3 RecordCircuit@gamerecords.c: circuitStats[circuit.type] of the circuit player's save and gTotalCircuitStats: count, 1st/2nd/3rd from gCircuitCars[0].totalPlace, death mode, points, best points and time; SavePlayerCircuitStats

MAT3 UpdateCircuit(ranks, time)@circuit.c: swaps ranks 0/1 for player 1, packs 3-bit ranks, track++, totalTime += time, ContinueCircuit, gCircuitTrack--, RecordCircuit at the end, difficulty bump (spreads 20/6), SavePlayerCircuit

MAT3 RecordBattle@gamerecords.c: battleStats[gTrackNum-6] of each save and gTotalBattleStats: kills/deaths from gBattlePoints, matches, wins (ranked first, same gCarTeam or tied); SavePlayerStats; no graphics
MAT3 RecordObstacle@gamerecords.c: obstacleStats[gTrackNum-18]: time, races, finished (gLap == 1) with best time, crashes, death mode counts
MAT3 RecordStunt@gamerecords.c: stuntStats[gTrackNum-14]: best stunt, best average (points / gStuntModeMins), points, time, crashes, the 10 stunt counters; no audio
MAT3 RecordGhost@gamerecords.c: a finished ghost race's time into the top-5 scores[2] (save and gTotalRaceStats, gNewTotalScore/gTotalNames shifted), races, ghosts, laps, time, miles; no drones
MAT3 RecordPractice@gamerecords.c: mileage/528 into raceStats[track].totalMiles of the save and the totals, SavePlayerStats; places nothing
MAT3 RecordRace@gamerecords.c: best-lap and average-lap top-5 tables (gLapTimes), 1st/2nd/3rd, death mode, crashes, laps, time, miles for each save and gTotalRaceStats, SavePlayerStats
MAT3 RecordGameOver@gamerecords.c: switch on gRace: 0/3 RecordRace, 1 RecordPractice, 2 RecordGhost, 4 RecordStunt, 5 RecordObstacle, 6 RecordBattle; no lighting

MAT3 updateHighScoreScreen@highscorescr.c: _InitScreen first, soft reset -> state 0, then 1 ControlUnlocked, 2 ControlCircuitCode (inlined), 3 ControlName per player then the ghost compress and save prompt, 4 ControlGhost, 5 ControlScores (inlined); no billboards

after SetupFontData(0) copies the character code (byte +4 of each 12-byte gFontLetters entry) of the current font's gFontHeader->numChars letters into out, NUL-terminated; no MAT3 counterpart, no caller in the C

MAT3 HAL_SetMenuTextDepth@HAL_text.c: controls_animButtonText calls it with a button's depth - 10 as MAT3 controlscr.c does; the N64 maps the depth through menu_text_depth_curve first, then HAL_SetTextDepth's tail (gDepth, attribute bit 0x10, BlitZDist)
MAT3 DrawBlits@blit.c: calls each of the NumBlits BlitPtrs' animFunc (name != -1), RemoveBlit and step back when it returns 0; symbols.json also has the alias update_active_objects at this address
MAT3 UpdateGraphics(drawBlits, updateEnvirons)@gfx.c: DrawBlits if drawBlits, UpdateEnvirons if updateEnvirons, UpdateCameras, ZOID_EndFrame(0); no audio

MAT3 ClearScreen: updateGameOverScreen's soft reset calls ClearScreen(1) there, func_800F7448(1) here (the GC body is an empty NGC stub); N64-only body: fill the current RGBA16 colour image with the colour (gDPSetColorImage, FillRectangle)
MAT3 IsCircuitUnlocked(circuit)@gamerecords.c: any player's gUnlockedCircuits[p][circuit]; the seven Is*Unlocked sit here in reverse MAT3 order
MAT3 IsFrameUnlocked(p, frame)@gamerecords.c: gUnlockedFrames[p][frame]
MAT3 IsTiresUnlocked(p, tires)@gamerecords.c: gUnlockedTires[p][tires]
MAT3 IsTransUnlocked(p, trans)@gamerecords.c: gUnlockedTrans[p][trans]
MAT3 IsEngineUnlocked(p, engine)@gamerecords.c: gUnlockedEngines[p][engine]
MAT3 IsCarUnlocked(p, car)@gamerecords.c: gUnlockedCars[p][car]
MAT3 IsTrackUnlocked(track)@gamerecords.c: any player's gUnlockedTracks[p][track]

MAT3 AddPlayerStats(player)@gamerecords.c: adds a profile's 12 race, 4 stunt, 8 battle, 1 obstacle and 4 circuit stat records into the gTotal*Stats tables (sums, maxima, ORed coins, smallest best time)
MAT3 IsCoinFound(p, coin)@gamerecords.c: 1 in attract mode, else the coin bit of raceStats[gTrackNum] (tracks 0-5) or stuntStats[gTrackNum-14] (14-17) of the player's save or gJustPlayers' record
MAT3 FoundCoin(p, coin)@gamerecords.c: sets the coin bit in raceStats[track] and [track+6] (tracks 0-5) or stuntStats[track-14], SavePlayerCoins; interpolates nothing
MAT3 RecordBattlePoints(to, from, points)@gamerecords.c: gBattlePoints[to][from] += points
MAT3 InitBattlePoints@gamerecords.c: clears gBattlePoints (16) and gTeamPoints (4); no audio. The name exists as a PC stand-in copy of this function (display_list_flush's group)
MAT3 ResetHighScores@gamerecords.c: gLap 0 and gBestLapTime 5999.999 per player, gNewTotalScore all -1
MAT3 setGameOverState(newState)@gameoverscr.c: leaving state 1 RemovePanes(0); entering 1 the title pane at titlePos and a menu pane as wide as the widest valid option
empty 8-byte function, never called: IDO's leftover of MAT3's static initScreen, which updateGameOverScreen inlines (gameover.c's header)
MAT3 uninitScreen@gameoverscr.c (static, in nine screens): setGameOverState(0), RemovePanes(1), RemoveBlit(blit), inited 0; no audio
MAT3 controlMain@gameoverscr.c: A/B runs gMainSelect (score, race again, new mode/track/car, next race, quit via gSkipToGameState), up/down skip invalid options
empty 8-byte function, never called: IDO's leftover of MAT3's static controlScore, which updateGameOverScreen inlines (state 2; gameover.c's header)

MAT3 updateGameOverScreen@gameoverscr.c: initScreen inlined (state 1, first valid option, NewMultiBlit), BlinkResurrectingCars, soft reset path (UnloadTrack, RemoveEnvirons, ClearScreen(1)), controlMain / controlScore
MAT3 camera.c SetCameraView(camera): zeroes cur_acc[camera] (D_801526A8, f32[4][3]); PlayGame calls it when a restarted car gets its view back, as in MAT3

MAT3 checkpoint.c CheckCPs: mileage += magnitude(dr_pos - gPrevPos), plane test against gCheckpoints.points[next_cp] -> PassedCP, then FindMaxpathIntervals, PlaceUnlockedCars and the 3 s first-place sound; only a never-defined prototype in include/game/checkpoint.h has the name
MAT3 drones.c static _LinearInterp (leading underscore dropped: reserved identifier): same clamps, 1e-3 midpoint case, slope/offset; the N64 argument order is (in1, in2, input, out1, out2)
empty 8-byte deleted-procedure stub, no callers: MAT3 drones.c's static _AssignDrones, which IDO inlined into DoDrones (its body follows SetCatchup there), emitted right before DoDrones; deletable

MAT3 drones.c DoDrones: SetCatchup (func_800DE860), then the inlined _AssignDrones body (place scale, 1 - gDifficulty/5, circuit skill [track + 6*backwards], boost/brake bounds through LinearInterp); renders nothing; only a prototype in include/game/drone.h has the name

MAT3 game.c PlayGame: Update_MDrive, race switch (stunt CheckForStunt, battle overlay shots/powerups, obstacle GetResPt, else DoDrones + CheckCPs), UpdateSmoke, UpdateArrowVis, per-car restart block (StartBlast, sounds, view save, SetCameraView), TextureAnimation, DetectDroneAbort, ShowHUD unless gRestartGame
MAT3 camera.c init_steady_move_cam(car): pos = dr_pos + 80*dr_uvs[2] + 20*dr_uvs[0], y + 5, then steady_move_cam(0, car, pos, uvs); include/game/camera.h has a stale void prototype of the name
MAT3 camera.c init_views (N64 without the attract branch): per window car = gCamera[i].slot, car->camera = i, init_view3, view = 7, init_steady_move_cam; clears finish_cam[]; no post-processing
MAT3 drones.c InitDrones: old_drone_scale[6] and old_boost[6] set to 1.0; include/game/drone.h has a prototype of the name
MAT3 checkpoint.c InitCPS: gEndGame = 0, gNumLapsLeft = gNumLaps; include/game/checkpoint.h has a prototype of the name

MAT3 audio.c EnableGameSounds(enabled): gGameSoundsEnabled = enabled, effects volume enabled ? 0 : gOptions[13]/10 through AudSetMasterVol(.., music 0, sfx 1); PrePlay's first call as in MAT3; nothing to do with vsync

MAT3 game.c PrePlay(useHud, cancel): SetOptions, EnableGameSounds, the high-score replay branch, AudKillSong/ZOID_Reset/InitWaves, munge_gLink_data, GhostStart, ResetHighScores, LoadTrack between the loading effects, InitCPS, init_cars, carsetup_flag[6] = 0, InitDrones, gGravity, Init_MDrive, init_views, ShowHUD

runs one UpdateFrame when the caller is thread 7 (the game thread, src/rom/lib_2cf0.c), the test save_settings makes in its wait loop; two unused args, no direct caller (a callback); MAT3's stripped UpdateFrameForPad/UpdateFrameForMC are candidates

MAT3 game.c _DrawNoControllers with its blit's _animScrollText merged in: finds the first unplugged controller (gControllerData[i].attached), scrolls the controller-removed text from x = 320 one pixel a call; GameLoop calls it where MAT3 calls _DrawNoControllers

MAT3 game.c static _EndGame: End_MDrive each car, appearance &= ~8, UpdateVisuals, modelstop, StopListeners, SetCountdownTimer(4), setGameState(0x2000000); retail has an 8-byte deleted stub here (inlined into UpdateGame), the tree's C body is _EndGame's
8-byte jr-ra stub, no caller: IDO's leftover of a procedure inlined at every call site, emitted among UpdateGame's callees; which procedure is not known
MAT3 game.c static _CheckButtons: an empty loop over gNumPlayers; UpdateGame calls it after CountDown and after PlayGame as in MAT3
MAT3 checkpoint.c InitCPTime: gInFirstPlace = 0, gFirstPlaceTime = 0, per car mileage = 0 and gPrevPos = dr_pos
MAT3 checkpoint.c CalcRaceTime: ghostRaceTimes[gTrackNum] for a ghost race on tracks 0..5, else 600
MAT3 countdown.c CountDown: gCountDown = GetCountdownTimeRemaining + 0.999, setGameState(0x100000) at <= 0; include/game/state.h has a prototype of the name

MAT3 game.c static _UpdateGame: the race state machine on gGameState 0x40000..0x2000000 (pole positions, PrePlay, countdown, start, play and the stunt/battle/race end rules, end, high-score and game-over screens); the symbol table's state_*_handler labels inside it are its case labels

MAT3 front.c updateBG: scrolls the four background polys' texture coordinates by gFrameSeconds * gBackRects[gNumWindows-1][poly].del, the -4/+4 wrap vote, records the offsets, offsetsValid[gNumWindows-1] = 1

MAT3 demo.c static endDemoGame (retail: deleted stub, inlined into playDemoGame; tree C has the body): End_MDrive, modelstop, StopListeners, RemoveHUD, RemoveEnvirons, RemoveCar each car, gPlayers[i].slot = i

MAT3 demo.c static playDemoGame(show): gDemoInited, gNumWindows = 1, gRace = 0 + fake_init(gCurrentDemoTrack), PrePlay then CarSetup/Update_MDrive/InitCPTime, else PlayGame; the hide path ends the demo and unloads the track
MAT3 demo.c static uninitDemoGame (retail: deleted stub, inlined): RemoveBlit(blit), playDemoGame(0, 0), inited = 0

MAT3 demo.c static nextAvailDemoTrack (retail: deleted stub, inlined): gCurrentDemoTrack++, wraps after 6 tracks setting gShowCredits; the N64 also wraps after 5 (setting gShowCredits) while D_80156994 is 0
MAT3 demo.c static initDemoGame (retail: deleted stub, inlined): NewMultiBlit(multiblit), SetCountdownTimer(30), nextAvailDemoTrack, inited = 1, ClearRushControls
MAT3 demo.c updateDemoGame: initDemoGame once, playDemoGame(1, 0), soft reset or start/A or the timeout end the demo (setGameState 4, or 2 after the last track); no collision debugging

MAT3 front.c updateFrontEnd: one update*Screen per gGameState bit in MAT3's order (license, warning, title, demo, start with gMirrorWaves = 0, records, player, mode, circuit, track, car, options, controls, audio, video, pak, cheat), then updateBG and SaveServer(0, 0)
(scheduler tick - gLastKeyTime) * seconds per tick: the time since a controller was last used; the same expression is inlined in GameLoop's 300 s idle test; no direct caller

MAT3 game.c GameLoop: sInited/gFrames, updateGameState, updateFrontEnd on 0x7C03FFFE, updatePauseScreen on 0x200000|0x400000, UpdateGame on 0x3FC0000, DrawNoControllers + the graphics update when gNewGameState == gGameState; N64 adds the 300 s idle blit
returns a[0]*b[3] + a[1]*b[4] + a[2]*b[5]: vector a dotted with row 1 of the 3x3 matrix b (BodyVector's y component alone); no caller in the image or the overlays
MAT3 fmath.c ScaleUVXYZ(a, b, sx, sy, sz): b's rows are a's rows times sx, sy, sz; called by overlay A

MAT3 controls.c FindPlayerNum(num, force): if forced or the player is unassigned (controller 5) and pressed start, controller = num and edges/levels/autoEdges/analog copied from gContEdges/gContLevels/gAutoEdges/gContStick, SetControllerActive; nothing random
MAT3 collision.c MiniForceApart(m, dir): force magnitude by crashflag, x-only below the 1e-4 length, BodyVector into reckon.uvs, added to centerForce

MAT3 collision.c setMiniFBCollisionForce(m, m1, m2, dir, pos): same 2500/4000/10000/20000/100 constants, bbox front/back/left/right tests, MiniForceApart early out, mass average, gSuicideMode and 0.8*crashthreshold crash rule

MAT3 circuit.c NewCircuit(type): clears the player's tCircuit (0x4C) and writes it, type, seed = gSeconds & 0xFFFFF, active = 1, totalTime = 0, death from gOptions[31], difficulty = gCircuitDiff[type]

MAT3 circuit.c SetCircuitCode(code): NewPassword(86, 14), SetPasswordString, GetPasswordElement 3/1/5/20/3 bits and 6x9, the track and points checks against gNumCircuitTracks/gCircuitPoints, NewCircuit, ContinueCircuit

under the heap lock (heap_lock_queue) frees (DeallocateMemoryInternal) the data of car palette record [index] (D_8013FEF4 = palBase of the 24-byte records at D_8013FEE0); called by overlay B; no statistics
adds dx, dy to a blit's x, y, UpdateBlit, and recurses down its child link (+0x3C); no MAT3 counterpart found; no timer
MAT3 blit.c SelectBlit(blt, index, hSize, vSize): RenameBlit if the texture is missing, then the cell's top/bot/left/right (flipped when blt->flip), UpdateBlit
returns 1 when no record of the sound voice table (gSfxInstances, sound_voice_count entries of 24 bytes) has its active byte set; no direct caller
8-byte jr-ra stub, no caller, among the audio sequence functions: IDO's leftover of an inlined procedure; which one is not known
stores its two register arguments to their home slots and returns; no caller in the code (perhaps a callback slot); does nothing else

deleted stub (retail) of the lookup inlined into stop_sequence: tag -1 or a tag whose record's id differs gives 0, else &gSequences[tag & gTagMask] (MAT3 ConvertTag's pattern, for sequences); the tree's game_timer_pause.c holds the body
under the audio lock (D_80142728) marks the sound sequence with tag h stopped (stop byte +0xE = 1), which the sequence processing then frees; MAT3 has only _StopAllSequences; no timer
